lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Cu10Co4 (reduced formula Mg6(Cu5Co2)2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 26 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis using CrystalNN identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Co and Cu centers each have 12 geometric neighbors, while Mg centers also show 12 neighbors, with neighbor distances spanning roughly 2.53–2.77 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 26 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and face-sharing between Cu and Mg polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg polyhedra.
